f3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.content:
## Project status → pipeline

The dispatcher of the status-driven connector pipeline (Appmixer-ai/appmixer-components#2890, step 1 in #2916).

`On Project Item Changed` receives `projects_v2_item` deliveries (action `edited`) through the GitHub connector's endpoint `/plugins/appmixer/github/events`, at which an organization owner points one organization webhook (github connector README). The bound account needs only `read:org` and `read:project`. `Status changed` keeps only moves of the Status field.

`Resolve the item` is one GraphQL call on the card's content node; `Pipeline event` turns it into `{issue?, pr?, connector, branch, status, from, runId}` — an issue is linked to its PR through the closing keyword, a PR card looks up no issue, the connector comes from the `appmixer:<x>` label. `runId` is deterministic (card, target status, `updated_at`), so a redelivery is recognised.

**Source of truth:** `.github/appmixer-flows/project-status-pipeline.json` in the connectors repo.

f3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002.content:
### One comment per item

`Comments on the item` reads the item's comments, `Pipeline comment` finds the one with `<!-- pipeline: {...} -->`, ends on a run id already recorded (`duplicate`), otherwise rewrites the comment with the new move. `Write the pipeline comment` creates or edits it (POST / PATCH). The comment goes to the issue when the card is an issue, else to the PR.

This version starts nothing else. The stage branches (Testing, Review, Doc&Verification, Needs input) hang on `Pipeline event` → `Resolved`.

fields.label: GitHub account
fields.tooltip: Reads the cards and their issues or pull requests and writes the pipeline comment (read:org, read:project, repo). The organization webhook that feeds the trigger is set up once by an organization owner on the connector endpoint — see the github connector README.

fields.label: Organization
fields.tooltip: Login of the organization that owns the project board.

fields.label: Project node ID
fields.tooltip: The board to watch (GraphQL node id, PVT_…). Empty = every board of the organization.

fields.label: OpenClaw hook headers
fields.tooltip: Headers of the calls that start the pipeline stages (Testing, Doc&Verification) on the OpenClaw gateway. Replace <OPENCLAW_HOOK_TOKEN> with hooks.token of the gateway.

fields.label: Pre-release flow URL
fields.tooltip: Webhook URL of the "CI - pre-release checklist" integration (its Webhook trigger). Keep it private: whoever has it can start the checklist.
